Pseudocode:

```{markdown}
Draw U ~ Uniform(0,1)
Set Z = 1 - sqrt(1-U)
```

```{r}
# Part (b): sample h(z) = 2(1-z) by inversion
set.seed(123)

n_samp <- 1e5

# Generate U ~ Uniform(0,1)
u <- runif(n_samp)

# Inverse CDF
z <- 1 - sqrt(1 - u)

# Sample mean
mean_z <- mean(z)

# Compare with theoretical mean = 1/3
mean_z
1/3
```
